message.content:
There are 7 distinct beads and 7 distinct positions: one center and 6 outer vertices of a regular hexagon.

The symmetry group of the hexagonal grid is the dihedral group \(D_6\), which has

\[
6 \text{ rotations} + 6 \text{ reflections} = 12
\]

symmetries total.

First count all placements without identifying symmetries:

\[
7! = 5040
\]

Since all 7 beads have distinct colors, no nontrivial symmetry can leave an arrangement unchanged. Indeed, any nontrivial rotation or reflection moves at least one position, so the bead at that position would have to equal the bead at its image, which is impossible with distinct colors.

Thus every equivalence class under rotations and reflections has exactly \(12\) arrangements.

Therefore the number of distinct arrangements is

\[
\frac{7!}{12} = \frac{5040}{12} = 420.
\]

The answer is 420.
